interpretation.plain_speak: The model still knows very well which examples are in danger, but its probability numbers are too pessimistic on the fresh phase: it predicts about 285 flips when 223 occur. Ranking is strong; absolute risk calibration is not stable enough yet.
interpretation.north_star_question: Separates discrimination from calibration. Wingless has a strong native danger ordering, but the numerical failure probability needs stability across phases before it can support a cost-aware action rule.
interpretation.next_stage: freeze the phase26 probability model unchanged and evaluate calibration drift across several additional held-out phases, measuring predicted/actual mass, Brier, ECE, AUROC, and AP without refitting
